purpose: Collect more genuine candidate specimen photo sources for distinct public research taxa with gaps; preserve identity evidence, photo source pages and SHA-256 bytes where rights permit, and add Stage 6 species anatomy evidence intake sidecars for each five-shard research output.
source_scope: Existing exact-name iNaturalist candidate observations, GBIF still-image occurrence leads and Wikimedia Commons file-page sources. Treat all candidate identifications and poses as unreviewed until human comparison with genuine specimen photographs.
copy_policy: Archive only photo-level CC0/CC BY iNaturalist source candidates under existing collection rules; retain restricted or unknown-licence records as source links only. No reuse for image generation without separate review.
anatomy_provenance: VNMV1_SPECIES_BOUND_ANATOMY_DOCTRINE_V1; all measurements UNKNOWN/null until published same-species voucher and independent photographic joint review.
do_not_include: Private card numbers, private original specimen images, owner human-gold annotations or measurements borrowed from other species.
